items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1960-07-29
items.q: I don't know Spanos. What was that?

ctx.x: I don't know Spanos. What was that? Well, that is the same thing. That's a tunk. What do they have? What we call it, tunk and cabaret. Cabaret is a higher grade than what the tunk was.
Would they have a full band and Spanos or piano or what?
